info.title: Luma Chat API
info.description: Express, MongoDB replica-set transactions and Socket.IO. JSON resources are unwrapped; lists use items/nextCursor. See docs/CONTRACT.md for socket schemas and token lifecycle.

servers.description: Development; use an HTTPS origin in production

get.description: Readiness responds 503 on database or configured Redis failure; liveness remains available.
Readiness responds 503 on database or configured Redis failure; liveness remains available.
Production requires Authorization: Bearer METRICS_TOKEN. Restrict ingress to the monitoring network.

post.description: Authentication quotas apply by IP and normalized identity. Codes expire after 10 minutes; 5 guesses maximum. Refresh rotation is single flight; replay revokes its session family.
post.x-database-indexes: users.email unique; sessions._id; sessions.expiresAt TTL; challenges(userId,kind,createdAt), expiresAt TTL

post.description: Revoke the current session, or every session of the authenticated user; device tokens are removed.
Revoke the current session, or every session of the authenticated user; device tokens are removed.

get.description: At most 100 active sessions; new logins revoke the oldest at capacity.

delete.description: Session must belong to the authenticated user.

patch.description: Avatar must be a ready image owned by the viewer and not assigned to a message or group.

delete.description: Immediately revoke access and scrub profile PII. Durable cleanup removes memberships and delegates remaining groups to another admin. Authored conversation content is retained under the documented policy.

get.description: Requires authentication; presence, last seen, bio and avatar honor privacy and block policy.
Exclude the viewer and blocks in either direction. Name substring or exact normalized email search. Sort by name and immutable ID.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page.

get.description: Bounded by the enforced 500-contact block-list capacity; bare array for existing frontend compatibility.

put.description: Target must be another active account. Direct sending is blocked both ways. Existing shared groups remain visible.
FCM must be configured. Device belongs to the current session; token is encrypted and indexed by a keyed digest.

get.description: Membership required. Pinned first, then activity descending and ID descending. Live inbox ordering can move during pagination; refresh the inbox on reconnect. At most 500 conversations per user.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page.

post.description: Verified active participants, no blocking with the creator. Unique direct pair; 2–256 participants; creator is admin.

patch.summary: Edit group or own chat preferences
patch.description: Name, description and avatar require a group admin. Pin, mute and archive are viewer-specific. Avatar is an owned ready image.

post.description: Only admins may add, remove, promote or demote. Leave requires the viewer’s own ID. Last admin must transfer the role, unless the group becomes empty.

get.description: Current membership required. Newest-first immutable sequence cursor. Search uses MongoDB full-word text search within the conversation. Joining members can see prior group history.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page.

post.description: Current membership; active direct peer, no direct blocks. Persist and commit before responding. Client ID is unique per sender; reuse with different original content returns 409. Uploads must be ready, owned, unassigned or already in the same chat. Replies must refer to a live message in this chat.
Current membership and a message in this chat. Cursors only increase; read implies delivered; read identities honor receipt preferences.
Current membership and a message in this chat. Cursors only increase; read implies delivered; read identities honor receipt preferences.

get.description: Current membership. Cursor pages scan up to limit messages; each message may yield up to 5 attachments or 20 HTTPS links. An empty page can still have a next cursor when MIME filtering excludes the scanned attachments.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page.

patch.description: Current membership; own message less than 15 minutes old; not deleted.

delete.description: Current membership; sender or group admin; not already deleted. URLs/text/reply/reactions are removed. Unreferenced objects are cleaned after retention.

put.description: Current member; one reaction per user per message. Same emoji removes it.

post.description: One file, server-configured maximum (default 20 MiB), no fields. MIME is sniffed; images decoded and rewritten to WebP with metadata stripped; production scanning is mandatory. Bounded to 3 concurrent uploads per instance.
S3 only. Ticket valid 5 minutes; upload to quarantine with returned headers. Completion validates actual bytes; claimed metadata is not trusted.
Owner only; pending object must be unexpired. Ready completion is idempotent. Actual size, file signature, scanner and image sanitation are applied before publishing the private object.

get.description: Owner for unassigned files; current membership and a live message for conversation files; group membership for group avatars; block and account status policies apply.

Bearer-capability URL bound to an active issuing session and current access policy, valid 180 seconds. Copied links work while authorized and unexpired; do not log or expose signatures. Supports a single explicit bytes=start-end Range.

SendMessage.description: Nonempty trimmed text or at least one attachment is required. Conversation comes from the REST path.
